title: Check and Terminate a Hung Application – Windows

purpose.text:
This procedure describes the standard steps to verify that an application is running and to forcibly
terminate it when it has stopped responding (hung).
purpose.quote: This procedure describes the standard steps to verify that an application is running and to forcibly

scope.text:
Applies to IT support staff and end users troubleshooting unresponsive desktop applications on Windows
systems.

roles.responsibility: Executes Check and Terminate a Hung Application – Windows

steps.action: Verify if the target application process is currently running.
steps.expected_outcome: If stdout contains '{{entities.application}}', set variables.process_running = true, else set variables.process_running = false
steps.quote: Verify if the target application process is currently running.

steps.action: Forcefully terminate the hung application process.
steps.expected_outcome: If exit code is 0, set variables.process_terminated = true, else set variables.process_terminated = false
steps.quote: Forcefully terminate the hung application process.

notes.text:
The /F flag forces immediate termination and skips cleanup, so any unsaved data in the application may
be lost.
